items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: the guy has teach me about Coleman Hawkins. “Body and Soul,” like in ‘37, all of that.

ctx.x: I like it. I want to buy it.

Or, I don’t know, and you’d try something else. So I went back home with that Coleman Hawkins and I was so proud because the guy has teach me about Coleman Hawkins. “Body and Soul,” like in ‘37, all of that. And when I got home with the new record that I bought, I’m very proud. Like I am nourishing a new regime with a teacher. And when I got, the next week, he said, “Oh you bought some records. What is that?” He said, “Oh bad luck?” You bought a record where, that’s an area where Coleman Hawkins started to play…
No you can’t. It appeals to you and you like it right away.
